text:
maria (runtime): quick async update — i merged the KV prefetch + continuous-batching integration into staging about 30m ago. main goals: reduce cold-start token p50 on short chats and improve kv hit-rate for multi-turns.

maria (runtime): current ask: need clear owners for rollout and a short-run checklist. spotted two blockers: 1) perf regression on some 8k sequence cases (looking like extra mem copies), 2) a flaky kv_eviction unit test that fails on linux-s390 in CI (super rare).

sam (kernel): ack. i can take the kernel-side investigation for the mem-copy path. preliminary hunch: the new serialize path in kernel/kv_store.cc calls memcpy on non-contig slices. i'll repro locally. can we get a representative repro config?

maria (runtime): thanks @sam. repro config: run bench_token_flow.sh with --seq-len 8192 --batch 4 --kv-prefetch=on on a 80GB GPU. linking the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4787

jordan (platform): for rollout: i can own the staging -> canary pipeline. we should gate canary on: a) p95 latency not increase by >3% for small seqs, b) no test flakes in 3 consecutive CI runs, c) no OOMs in dedicated 8k stretches. i'll prepare a canary checklist.

leo (perf): i ran a quick synthetic earlier — saw a ~6% p50 regression at seq=8192 in the merged branch vs main. attaching the bench output snippet:
```
seq=8192 batch=4 p50: main=120ms branch=127ms
p95: main=210ms branch=218ms
mem: branch shows +240MB RSS
```

leo (perf): seems consistent with a mem copy or extra allocation per token. @sam do you want the heap profiler dump?

sam (kernel): yes please -- heap dump + perf record would help. i'll add logging around the serialize/deserial paths.

maria (runtime): CI bot shows the flaky test failed in build 2024-03-10T11:02 (job: runtime-tests/linux-s390). @ci-bot can you paste the failing test log?

ci-bot: failing test: tests/kv_cache/test_eviction.py::test_eviction_race — assertion timeout after 30s. last log: "evict loop waited for 2s, queue not drained". rerun suggested: /ci rerun runtime-tests/linux-s390

maria (runtime): rerun kicked off. @tess can you coordinate with SRE on the flaky infra? it looks like an ephemeral CI runner network stall but want confirmation.

tess (prod-eng): on it. i'll ping infra and ask for runner logs for the 11:02 window. also will add a flaky-test override so it doesn't block canary gating if it's ephemeral (but we'll require 3 successful CI runs).

sam (kernel): timeline: i'll triage today, aim for a hotfix branch by EOD. if it's a serialize regression i can try reverting the new copy-lite path and test perf.

maria (runtime): ownership summary: sam -> kernel fix and repro, jordan -> canary rollout and gating checklist, leo -> perf benches & heap dumps, tess -> CI infra flake + canary override. i'll coordinate the release timeline: target soft-canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC assuming no high-sev regressions.

leo (perf): i'll run full perf suite on the same instance types (A100-80GB and A10G) and post a short table in the channel.

jordan (platform): noted. i'll prepare a canary job that pins to the merged commit and routes 5% traffic, auto-roll back on latency/oom triggers.

maria (runtime): quick Q for @sam and @leo — if the regression is mem-copy related, do we prefer a temporary revert or a micro-optimization in kernel? revert has faster mitigation but loses kv-prefetch improvements. suggestions?

sam (kernel): depends on root cause. if it's a small misplaced memcpy i can patch quickly. if it's structural (changed serialization layout) revert might be faster. i'll know after repro.

leo (perf): agree. if patch <= 1 day, prefer patch. otherwise revert to avoid canary risk.

maria (runtime): ok — plan: sam triage today, if no quick patch by 17:00 PT we revert and re-land after fix. jordan, hold canary until sam signals green. tess, please keep me posted on CI reruns.

sam (kernel): starting repro now. i'll post logs + a short PR if i find a fix. assigning self in the PR description.

ci-bot: rerun complete — 2/3 flakes passed, one transient runner reset. full log: https://ci.internal/job/1234/console

maria (runtime): thanks. that's all for now — i'll update this thread with any rollout changes. feel free to ping here for small async checks. :white_check_mark:

sam (kernel): quick note — found suspicious memcpy at kernel/kv_store.cc:412, testing a patch to use iovec + zero-copy. will post perf numbers in ~45m.

leo (perf): cool, i'll stand by to compare.

jordan (platform): added canary job draft: https://deploy.internal/canaries/kv-prefetch-canary — left it paused until we get green.

maria (runtime): great work team. closing this thread for updates; reopen if blockers show up during canary. :rocket:
